scope: Source-hashed excerpts of two historical experiments; not complete reproduction bundles, not new training or new evaluation. Original hashes identify unmodified source files, not this derived JSON.
derivation: CartPole aggregates all nine original confirmation result JSONs. Stream aggregates all30 original confirmation records and checks those aggregate values against the original summary. No trial selection.

cartpole.method: 128 supplied full numerical-state imitation targets per model; parameters frozen during 20 confirmation episodes for each of three model initializations per layout. No reward learning or teacher action fallback during evaluation.
cartpole.timing_scope: Measured learned action queries on shared Apple Silicon host; arithmetic mean of the three model means, each containing 10,000 actions. Learning timing is separate.
cartpole.matching: Same teacher examples, 20 environment seeds and numerical settings. flat6 and observer4_2 match six patch states but have 24 versus 40 edges and 30 versus 46 parameters; flat1 has one patch.
cartpole.nonclaim: No recursive-quality advantage: every trained model reaches the episode ceiling.

flat1.repair_sweep_derivation: (proposals - rejected backtracks) / actions, from the archived repair-counter contract

flat6.repair_sweep_derivation: (proposals - rejected backtracks) / actions, from the archived repair-counter contract

observer4_2.repair_sweep_derivation: (proposals - rejected backtracks) / actions, from the archived repair-counter contract

changing_body.matching: Same observations, history, actual stream and replay presentations. Different parameters, optimizer steps and computation. Cadence uses Python float64; conventional controls use PyTorch CPU float64 and one Torch/BLAS thread.

conditions.control: Private one-step goal probes every24events; behavior remains a common random-policy trajectory. No closed-loop control claim.

changing_body.timing_scope: Construction, actual-input forecasts, learning/replay, hypothetical action queries and final checkpoint probes. Excludes import, common stream generation and receipt I/O; shared host and unequal work.
nonclaims: Not matched capacity or compute; broader intelligence or a causal recursive-depth advantage is unestablished.
MLP is faster and lower on squared forecast error and goal error.
Restored A initially incurs more error than first acquisition; no protected old-skill recall.
